title: Quickstart Habitat: modular onboarding walkthrough artboards and empty-state illustrations
creator: Linnea Berg
description: Create a set of modular onboarding artboards and empty-state illustrations for the Console Quickstart Habitat flow. Deliverables include: a first-run checklist modal (compact and expanded variants), three empty-state illustrations with two tonal variants (illustrative and photo-overlay), microcopy for tips and tooltips, animated GIF prototypes for the interactive tile transitions, and a screenshot capture checklist for engineering handoff. Focus on clarity for new dev/ML-engineer personas, legible typography at 14px body, and color-safe contrast for console themes (light/dark). Avoid reusing existing art direction from previous onboarding packs; this ticket should produce a visually distinct suite that can be A/B tested against the baseline pack.

Animated GIF prototypes (tile expand/collapse, checklist progress) included and under 3MB each
Handoff package uploaded to Drive with Figma file link, redlines, and a screenshot capture checklist
Design review completed with PM and Eng and sign-off recorded in comments
